source.heading: Appendix C: Scenario Generator > 2. Factions
Appendix C: Scenario Generator > 2. Factions

rows.name: Claimant
rows.shortTerm: Seize the seat of the absence, or be first to act as what is missing
rows.longTerm: Be recognized as what is missing

rows.name: Guardian
rows.description: wants the old order back, with itself at the center
rows.shortTerm: Be acknowledged as indispensable to any settlement
rows.longTerm: Restore what is missing under its own oversight

rows.name: Threatened
rows.shortTerm: Win guarantees from two factions before the first Escalation
rows.longTerm: Have its survival written into the new order

rows.name: Opportunist
rows.shortTerm: Use the crisis to throw off its worst burden
rows.longTerm: Make the new order better for it than the old

rows.name: Creditor
rows.shortTerm: Turn two factions' obligations into leverage before the order is settled
rows.longTerm: Have its claims protected in whatever comes next

rows.name: Outsider
rows.description: was never part of the old order
rows.shortTerm: Win a seat where the settlement will be decided
rows.longTerm: Be part of the new order on equal terms
